title: sonchus ustulatus subsp. imbricatus
intro: Sonchus ustulatus subsp. imbricatus, commonly known as prickly sow thistle, is a plant species within the sunflower family and is often considered a medicinal plant. The prickly sow thistle is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immunomodulatory properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of various diseases. Its therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpene lactones, which have been shown to exhibit antimicrobial, antiviral, and anticancer activities. Further research is needed to fully understand the potential therapeutic applications and health benefits of Sonchus ustulatus subsp. imbricatus.
